blindness_caveat: A general web search for 'Broadcom VMware acquisition merger agreement 2022 2023 structure' returned several real, verbatim 8-K/10-Q/10-K excerpts (Broadcom's own 'Pending Acquisition of VMware' footnotes, and the real closing 8-K text) alongside Broadcom's own investor-relations press release. The event below is dated/scoped from Broadcom's press release only; the real 8-K/10-Q excerpts were used afterward, deliberately, to build and validate the extraction fix in this pass -- not to write this gold record.
note: User-suggested as 'the Multi-Tranche Platform Integration' use case, and it delivered exactly that: the real closing 8-K describes a FOUR-STEP sequence (First Merger, a mid-sequence Delaware corp-to-LLC Conversion, Second Merger, Third Merger) across SIX named entities (Broadcom, VMware, Verona Holdco Inc., Verona Merger Sub Inc., Barcelona Merger Sub 2 Inc., Barcelona Merger Sub 3 LLC) -- the most structurally complex real closing text tested this session. This pass found that the existing CONVERTED_TO pattern (built for an earlier, unrelated VMware corporate-conversion case) was hardcoded to fire only when 'VMware' was literally a known alias -- it happened to still work on this new deal purely because VMware is again the entity involved, not because the pattern was ever actually general. Confirmed and fixed -- see CONTEXT_EVENT_EXTRACTION_BROADCOM_VMWARE.md. Scoped to the Broadcom/VMware merger only (announced 2022-05-26, closed 2023-11-22).

events.notes: Agreement and Plan of Merger signed; ~$61B cash-and-stock deal, $142.50/share cash or 0.2520 Broadcom shares per VMware share, plus assumption of ~$8B VMware debt
